## Reviewer checklist
- [ ] Branch name is the Jira key plus the title in lowercase with hyphens, e.g. `SCRUM-42-add-lecture-endpoints`
- [ ] Code runs locally (`docker compose up`)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, or large binaries committed
- [ ] Relevant docs (README / Confluence) updated
- [ ] The PR targets `main`, and auto-merge is off
